### ① Derived judgments

Each rewritten line, judged against the rule text that must make it true on `main`:

1. `seat-post-protocol.md` L28 「常设半边是总监席摘要的座位贴活性巡查,同一判据,细则见 `dispatch-runbook.md`」 — TRUE. `dispatch-runbook.md` L41 「座位贴活性归总监席摘要:扫 `label:pm:seat` 挂 `🟢 <github-login>` 的贴」 under 〈巡查常设项(每项目巡查与总监席摘要)〉; `lanes/director.md` L75 「座位贴与在飞活性复查归本摘要,见 `../dispatch-runbook.md` 巡查常设项与 `../triage-duties.md`」. The pointer 「细则见 `dispatch-runbook.md`」 still resolves (L39–L43). The old 「分诊轮」 reading has no surviving carrier: `triage-duties.md` L5 says 「活性复查同归」 the director's digest.

2. `seat-post-protocol.md` L80 「生产者:主仓归总监席,objectui 与 cloud 归各自整仓座位」 — TRUE. `lanes/director.md` L76 「发版板 `target:<major>` 主仓归本席」 and L80 「每张板恰好一个生产者」; `triage-duties.md` L5 「发版板、pin 链归总监席摘要,细则见 director.md」. The sibling lines L81–L83 (「三个生产者」, three boards) stay consistent: director, objectui seat, cloud seat.

3. `seat-lifecycle.md` L38 「无心跳,活性归总监席摘要:逾一天无自有产出 ⇒ 座位贴当场降级,静默认领同钟先敲门」 — TRUE. The seat-post half: `dispatch-runbook.md` L41–L43 (「>24h 无自有产出 ⇒ 当场降级」, owned by the digest). The in-flight half (「静默认领同钟先敲门」): `triage-duties.md` L71 「在飞活性复查:认领逾一天无自有产出 … ⇒ 敲门一次」 under L5 「活性复查同归 [总监席摘要],细则留本文」, and `lanes/director.md` L75 names both 「座位贴与在飞活性复查」 as the digest's. Line unchanged in every other clause. (Not in the card's original list, but the same staleness as L39 on the same subject; declared in the claim's file surface.)

4. `seat-lifecycle.md` L39 「敲门后满 `RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS` 无答复即由总监席一笔中继释放,细则 `triage-duties.md`」 — TRUE, by inclusion. The release (`triage-duties.md` L72 「敲门后 `RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS = 12` 小时无答复 ⇒ `label-write.mjs --release` 一笔中继释放」 and L73 the `Release:` format) is the second step of the 在飞活性复查 block L71–L73, and that block's owner is fixed by L5 「活性复查同归 … 细则留本文」 and `lanes/director.md` L75. No line on `main` assigns the release step to any other seat, and the director already makes label and assignee writes in the same digest (`dispatch-runbook.md` L43 「改 `⏳ vacant` + 摘 assignee 同笔」), so the duty fits the director's write surface. The retained pointer 「细则 `triage-duties.md`」 is correct because L5 keeps the details in that file. Adversarial note: the duty is the director's by the ownership sentence, not by a sentence that names the release itself; the residual tension this leaves on `main` is in ③, not in this PR.

5. `seat-lifecycle.md` L47 「三类以 `finding` 入 skills 车道,首触归分诊席;三类之外默认关 not planned」 — TRUE. `lanes/skills.md` L22 「本车道 finding 同走分诊席首触,⛔ 不自分诊」; `triage-duties.md` L74 「每张卡欠一次分诊首触,车道 ⛔ 不自分诊」; `lanes/triage.md` L5 「范围 = objectstack、objectui 每张卡首触」. The old 「由该席分诊」 contradicted all three. Outside the card's quoted lines (see ③).

6. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` L15236, L15310, L15659: 「四仓全量对账」 → 「两仓全量对账」 in two comments and one H65 prescription string — TRUE and verbatim. `dispatch-runbook.md` L69 「每日层(当日首 fire)= 两仓全量对账 + 归集本就日频的职责。」 under 〈分诊两级盘点细则〉; `triage-duties.md` L10 「每日一 fire 跑两仓全量对账」. No 「四仓」 remains in `scripts/pm/` or `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` on the head. 四 and 两 are both 3 bytes, so each line's width is unchanged (110/105/121 B before and after); the 121 B line is in a file outside the ratchet's CEILINGS map.

Shape: line-neutral (`seat-lifecycle.md` 95→95 against ceiling 96; `seat-post-protocol.md` 91→91 against ceiling 91; `check-half-states.mjs` 35076→35076). Widest edited governed line 118 B (L38). No new rule, no new reader, no cross-file move. Commit trailers model-free (`Co-Authored-By: Claude`, `Claude-Session:`), no login in the commit; the login in the PR body is the relay's standard attribution header, as on merged PR #25593. Sweep of every 「分诊」 mention in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` on the head, excluding `triage-duties.md` and `lanes/triage.md`: no other line assigns seat-post liveness, the knock-and-release, the main-repo release board, or lane self-triage to the triage seat. `cross-repo-coordination.md` L7 and `seat-lifecycle.md` L76 are untouched, as 6377494099 ruled them moot (「析取④」 exists again at `triage-duties.md` L15).

Gate verdicts on this head (their conclusions are the verdicts; last read at 2026-10-24T13:46Z): success — Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · ESLint, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, The card this PR closes must claim this branch, No other open PR may claim the same issue, No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path, Part-of PR must not also close its card, Snapshot the board to the archive branch, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test Core 2/6–6/6, Auto Label, filter. Skipped (path-filtered or opt-in) — Build Core, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Regression Gate shards, Packed-tarball smoke, 18.x upgrade harness, and the duplicate Check Changeset / Check PR Size / Auto Label rows on the two extra runs. Still in progress at the last read (2026-10-24T13:46Z, six reads over seven minutes): Test Core (1/6), Live half-state sweep. No red at any read. This verdict is on the diff and the rule text; landing waits for the two in-progress runs to conclude green, as the claim's own Tier S terms require.

### ② Semver level

skip-changeset. No package source moves: two governed skill reference files and comment/prescription strings in a PM script off the published surface. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body is right: nothing in the diff widens an accepted set or a public face. `Metadata-protocol: none` matches.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. `Premise:` template line (6377494099 「Added」; PR body 「Not done here」) — deferral ACCEPTED on its conclusion, with its stated reason corrected. The PR body says 「no adjacent pair merges under 120 bytes」. Measured on `main`: `SKILL.md` L201+L202 join at 117 B (「- ready/draft 走中继 op;MCP 兜底已拒;端点见 rest-channel；④ 轮次报告单列 awaiting a human merge。」), so the sentence is literally false. But that join splices ③'s sub-point onto enumerated rule ④, which the ratchet's own precedent refuses (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` L321–L322 「smallest 121 B, and that one splices two rules」), the template's own short pairs (L303+L304 at 46 B, L306+L307 at 62 B) are machine-read key lines whose merge would change the claim format, and the wrapped-prose pairs (L261+L262 at 105 B) are re-wrap funding, refused by `lanes/skills.md` L20 「⛔ re-wrap 筹行」. So at 318/318 the line does need a ruled raise, and 抬天花板 is on the human floor (`triage-duties.md` L83). Owed at landing: a carrier. Once 「Fixes #25490」 closes the card the item has none; the seat should put the 318→319 raise on a decision card (as #25593 did) or file the follow-up under filing gate ③ before the card closes, and name it on the PR.

2. 选层 quote in the same H65 prescription — deferral ACCEPTED. The quoted 「选层按 fire 时刻,⛔ 不用计数器;简报写明本轮跑的层」 now reads 「选层按 fire 时刻 ⛔ 不用计数器,简报写明层」 at `triage-duties.md` L10; same meaning, outside the card's quoted surface, and `triage-duties.md` L39 says `check-*` 处方句 are not a declared contract. One correction to the PR body: 「has no such heading」 is wrong — `triage-duties.md` L1 is `# 分诊座位职责`, so 〈分诊座位职责〉 resolves to the file's title; only the wording of the quote drifted.

3. Scope widening, declared: `seat-lifecycle.md` L47 (and L38) are not among the card's six quoted lines nor in 6377494099. Both were declared in claim 6384878747 before the PR, sit in the claimed file surface, are line-neutral and correct the same staleness. Accepted; noted so the record matches the card.

4. Residual on `main`, not this PR's: `triage-duties.md` L3 「本文是分诊座位的全部职责」 and L70 「例外仅下三行:敲门在先」 still frame L71–L73 as a triage exception while L5 assigns 活性复查 to the director's digest; `lanes/director.md` L16 「未回字 = 不在 = 停,⛔ 无巡检」 means a digest-owned release only runs while a director is summoned. Pre-existing after #25422/#25552; a skills-lane follow-up if anyone reads the three lines as triage's.

5. Out of surface, not a moved duty: `seat-post-protocol.md` L73 「命中 ⇒ 分诊座位在父单评论询问,再静默一窗后摘 `pm:epic` 收回子树」 assigns the zombie-epic reclaim to the triage seat, which `triage-duties.md` (L3 「全部职责」) never lists. Label plus comment, so inside `lanes/triage.md` L4's write surface; neither #25414 nor #25552 moved it. Not in the card's grep terms; recorded only.

6. The PR body's 「Widest edited line 118 bytes」 holds for the governed files; the `check-half-states.mjs` string line is 121 B before and after (width-neutral, off the register).
